item: Row 461: every value put into a sentence with String.replace is inserted as written, guarded app-wide
summary: After row 458 (app-backup.js), the same sweep across the app's own scripts: 75 String.replace calls with a string pattern and a non-literal replacement (counts, dates, model names, server reasons, paths, file-name templates) in 15 scripts now pass a function, so a $&, $', $` or $$ in the value is no longer read as a replacement pattern. One site whose replacement was already a function reference (the restore checklist's Hugging Face folder) now calls it inside the arrow. Two more unvalidated server lists in app-backup.js (the failed-verify volume names, an export category list) read as empty when not an array. tests/test_replace_function_form_row461.py fails on any new string-pattern replace whose replacement is neither a literal nor a function, with an anti-vacuity check on the scanner. No string, locale or server change.
